patterns.message: Deep imports into module internals are forbidden. Import ONLY from the module public API: '@/modules/<name>'.
Relative imports crossing module boundaries are forbidden. Use '@/modules/<name>'.
Deep imports into module internals are forbidden. Import ONLY from the module public API: '@/modules/<name>'.
UI (src/app, src/components) must NEVER import Prisma or module repositories directly. Route handlers must call module services; UI components must use contracts or API endpoints.
